text: Not really as described on picture. Colour and transparency are completely different also very few.. Arrived fast but other than that there were very few hearts on my bag it was a very small bag it'd be convenient if they noted how many hearts or at least how heavy the bag is just to have a heads up. Also the hearts do not look at all like the picture are not as pink nor transparent they are pretty much a very light pink but solid colour!
